# ankra_ai_endpoints (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The counterpart of `ankra ai endpoints list`; needs the `ai.manage` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_ai_endpoints" "all" {}

output "endpoint_ids" {
  value = { for endpoint in data.ankra_ai_endpoints.all.endpoints : endpoint.name => endpoint.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Configured endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `base_url` (String) Base URL.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the endpoint.
- `key_preview` (String) Masked preview of the stored key.
- `name` (String) Endpoint name.
- `provider` (String) Provider kind.
